history.summary: A 32-year-old freehold 3BR in D19 priced at $1,803 PSF — a 27% premium to the project's $1,419 URA median PSF with no clear justification. Old age, sub-100 score, walkability concerns to the future CRL station and a thin 21-txn series make this an easy pass.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,803 PSF vs $1,419 URA median = +27% over recent transactions, a steep premium for a 1994-built freehold. score_1000 of just 126 is the worst in the batch. 900m/11-min walk to the future CR9 Serangoon North (CRL ~2030) is too far to capture the MRT uplift. At $2.0M for a dated 3BR the unit competes against far newer D19 stock.
red_flags: +27% asking PSF over URA median with no catalyst
900m to MRT — outside the uplift radius
